monetaryBasis: Net of VAT; real/nominal consistency is a planning assumption; no terminal value
scope: Illustrative named starting cohort; not a closed cohort (replacement inflow retained)

booking.task: Booking flow, hub-zone logic and credits in the app
booking.current: In-app hold of a nearby scooter for a few minutes; unlock now
booking.limitation: No booking ahead, no hub zones, no promise that a scooter will be there

booking.task: Overnight placement inside existing night routes
booking.current: Night crews rebalance and swap batteries against a demand forecast
booking.limitation: Placement is not tied to individual next-morning bookings

booking.task: Hub demand forecast, holdout design and CPE tracking
booking.limitation: No randomised holdout or customer-level incrementality tracking

booking.task: Pricing, Pass terms and commitments in the Oslo bid
booking.limitation: No price for a guaranteed scooter; bid commitments not linked to segments

booking.task: Credit and exception process for failed bookings
booking.current: Ride complaints and refunds handled case by case
booking.limitation: No standard credit when a promise is broken

group.task: Invitations, shared meeting point, nearby-vehicle view
group.current: Group Rides: one account unlocks up to five scooters and pays for all
group.limitation: No invitations, shared meeting point or nearby-scooter view for guests

group.task: Short group hold at the meeting point
group.limitation: No hold for several scooters at one meeting point

group.kpi: Completion of groups with new guests
group.current: The host pays for every scooter
group.limitation: Guests never register, so Voi cannot reach them again

group.task: Repeat-use journey after the first group trip
group.limitation: No follow-up journey triggered by a group trip

group.task: Event and venue partners: selection, funding per group and duties
group.limitation: No agreements where venues pay for the groups they receive

group.task: Group issues and evening safety follow-up
Join by link without the app (web check-in for guests)
group.kpi: Share of guests joining by link; groups started per occasion
group.current: Guests ride on the host's account
group.limitation: Every guest must download the app to see the group

group.task: Uplift targeting: offer the group incentive only where it changes behaviour
group.kpi: Extra groups per krone of incentive (A/B)
group.limitation: Discounts also go to groups that would ride anyway

group.task: First ride free for new guests after a group trip
group.kpi: Guests with a first paid ride within 30 days
group.limitation: Not tied to the guest's first group trip

common.task: Sponsor, pilot owner, budget ownership and gate reviews
common.limitation: No single pilot owner, budget or gate review

demand.source: No fitted forecast; explicit seasonality scenario

register.label: Horizon
register.scope: Finite horizon with no terminal value: a conservative choice.

register.label: Use illustrative Oslo market scale
register.scope: On: infer active customers from city trips and assumed usage. Off: use the named starting cohort below. Neither mode makes the sample segment shares representative of Oslo.

register.label: Named starting cohort: active customers
register.scope: Used when market scaling is off. Setup, monthly organizational costs and logistics capacity stay as entered. Baseline replacement inflow is maintained: this is a bounded operating portfolio, not a closed attrition-only cohort.

register.label: Discount rate (annual)
register.scope: Cost-of-capital proxy for a growth-stage operator.

register.label: NOK per EUR (2025 average)
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Oslo share of Voi Norway revenue
register.scope: Applies only in illustrative Oslo market mode. Not observed; compare the conditional equal-group-revenue-per-trip check without treating it as a measured city share.

register.label: Oslo rental e-scooter trips 2025
register.scope: 20.4m in 2025 (11.2m in 2024), all operators.

register.label: Voi share of Oslo trips
register.scope: An analyst-selected 35.5%, between Voi’s 2024 trip share (4.1m of 11.2m = 36.6%) and its 2025 fleet share (5,334 of 16,000 = 33.3%). The 2025 trip share is not reported.

register.label: Vehicle operating cost per ride
register.scope: (Revenue − vehicle profit) / rides, 2025. An average, not a marginal cost.

register.label: Pass monthly price assumption (incl. VAT)
register.scope: 399 kr is a historical 2024 benchmark used as a scenario input. It is not a verified current Oslo price. Voi directs customers to the app for city-specific prices; replace this assumption with a dated in-app observation when available.

register.label: VAT on e-scooter rental
register.scope: Skatteetaten classifies vehicle rental without a driver at the ordinary rate, currently 25% (checked 21 Oct 2026). The model applies that rental classification to the Pass and related booking fees and credits; reported Voi revenue is already net of VAT. Treatment of any proposed service is a model application of the rule, not an individual ruling.

register.label: Office labour cost per hour
register.scope: Voi personnel cost per average employee / about 1,650 hours. Used for build and running hours.

register.label: Field operations cost per hour
register.scope: SSB 2025: stock, freight and van workers 262–309 kr/h × about 1.29 employer costs, plus night supplement.

register.label: Launch investment budget
register.scope: Illustrative sponsor allocation, not a budget specified by Assignment 2. Includes scale-up purchased at launch in direct rollout.

register.label: Card and payment fees on extra revenue
register.scope: Typical Nordic acquiring cost, applied only to incremental revenue.

register.label: Product maintenance a year (share of setup)
register.scope: Keeps the features running from launch; avoidable if an offer stops.

register.label: Seasonal swing in ride volume
register.scope: Explicit scenario, not fitted seasonality. The 40% seasonal case is an analogue-informed stress, not a Voi estimate.

register.label: Peak month of the season
register.scope: Model month 1 is October 2026, so 10 is July 2027.

register.label: Convenience Seekers share (scenario weight)
register.scope: 22 of 72 (QCL_4 = 3). A sample share, not a market share. Applying this sample fraction to a customer portfolio is an assumption. Compare alternative weights under Uncertainty & risk. Applied to the operating cohort as an assumed mix. Sample membership does not establish the market or pilot population share.

register.label: Social Leisure Seekers share (scenario weight)
register.scope: 21 of 72 (QCL_4 = 1). Applying this sample fraction to a customer portfolio is an assumption. Compare alternative weights under Uncertainty & risk. Applied to the operating cohort as an assumed mix. Sample membership does not establish the market or pilot population share.

register.label: Cautious Riders share (scenario weight)
register.scope: 15 of 72 (QCL_4 = 2). Applying this sample fraction to a customer portfolio is an assumption. Compare alternative weights under Uncertainty & risk. Applied to the operating cohort as an assumed mix. Sample membership does not establish the market or pilot population share.

register.label: Transport Connectors share (scenario weight)
register.scope: 14 of 72 (QCL_4 = 4). Applying this sample fraction to a customer portfolio is an assumption. Compare alternative weights under Uncertainty & risk. Applied to the operating cohort as an assumed mix. Sample membership does not establish the market or pilot population share.

register.label: Calibrate segment engagement to survey usage
register.scope: Scales upward moves per segment so that its share of frequent riders and subscribers matches its share of weekly users, shrunk toward the pooled share.

register.label: CS: users riding weekly or more
SLS: users riding weekly or more
register.scope: 5 of 20 users.

register.label: CR: users riding weekly or more
register.scope: 0 of 13 users.

register.label: TC: users riding weekly or more
register.scope: 4 of 13 users.

register.label: All users riding weekly or more
register.scope: 21 of 68. TØI 2019: 42% (Nov) to 70% (summer); Voi 2025: about half.

register.label: Shrinkage toward the pooled share
register.scope: Clusters have 13–22 users; 50% guards against over-reading small cells.

register.label: Alternative: scale upgrades by Q24 subscription interest
register.scope: Stated interest, not purchase probability. Off by default.

register.label: Rides a month: Occasional rider
register.scope: Survey users below weekly, Q1 band midpoints.

register.label: Rides a month: Frequent rider
register.scope: Weekly-plus riders without a Pass: 12.1.

register.label: Rides a month: Subscriber (Voi Pass)
register.scope: Current subscribers: 15.2 (n=6).

register.label: Occasional → Frequent
register.scope: Baseline transition is assumed. Cross-sectional usage cannot identify monthly transitions.

register.label: Occasional → Subscriber
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Occasional → Inactive
register.scope: Assumed 10% a month. No operator-specific cohort retention estimate was supplied for this project.

register.label: Frequent → Occasional
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Frequent → Subscriber
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Frequent → Inactive
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Subscriber → Occasional
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Subscriber → Frequent
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Subscriber → Inactive
register.scope: Assumed 3.5% a month (about 35% a year). Survey Q23: 5 of 11 respondents who have ever had a Pass no longer have one. That shows subscribers do leave, but without an observation period it cannot give a monthly rate.

register.label: Inactive → Occasional (win-back)
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Inactive → gone for good
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Use the city-wide footprint
register.scope: Selects the separate city-wide reach and placement assumptions. Changing the footprint does not change the fee, demand response, fulfilment or logistics capacity.

register.label: Hub footprint: eligible Convenience Seekers
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: City-wide footprint: eligible Convenience Seekers
register.scope: 80% is an illustrative reach assumption, not a survey estimate. City-wide remains focused on CS; it does not automatically acquire other segments. Test reach independently from the fee and placement need.

register.label: City-wide footprint: bookings requiring placement
register.scope: 50% is an analyst scenario. The matched-price table exposes it next to the separate hub assumption. No observed Oslo placement fraction establishes this value.

register.label: Eligible frequent riders who book
register.scope: Of eligible frequent riders without a Pass, the share who book in a given month.

register.label: Eligible subscribers who book
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Bookings per booking customer
register.scope: Eight is about two commute days a week.

register.label: Bookings included in Voi Pass
register.scope: The upgrade incentive scales with the share of bookings the Pass covers; every included booking still costs a placement.

register.label: Booking fee (incl. VAT)
register.scope: Set at 35 kr: at 25 kr a booking costs more to place and hold than it earns. The adoption inputs were set for 25 kr and the central case assumes demand holds at 35 kr; the price table under Explore the offers shows the value if it falls. Benchmarks: Voi’s free-unlock add-on 29 kr a month; Dott and Lime 10–15 minute holds free.

register.label: Demand response to the fee
register.scope: Unestimated planning coefficient. Default 1; sensitivity range 0–2 is a scenario range, not an empirical confidence interval.

register.label: Use bounded logit price response
register.scope: Alternative unestimated demand structure. Linear and logit share adoption at the reference fee and the same local price elasticity there. Logit(p) = logit(p0) − elasticity × (fee − reference) / reference / (1 − p0), for 0 < p0 < 1. Price-response envelopes and the assumption challenge test both forms. Train (2009), chapter 3, motivates the probability form, not its Voi parameter values.

register.label: Fee at which adoption is estimated
register.scope: The adoption inputs describe demand at this fee.

register.label: Bookings fulfilled on time
register.scope: Scooter present and charged at the booked time.

register.label: No-shows
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Credit per failed booking (incl. VAT)
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Hub footprint: bookings requiring placement
register.scope: Hub bookings where a scooter must be moved overnight; the rest are met by holding one already nearby.

register.label: Minutes per placement
register.scope: Field time to move and park one scooter: about 1 minute of handling plus a 1–3 km detour at about 20 km/h.

register.label: Vehicle cost per placement
register.scope: Planning allowance of 20 NOK for vehicle costs beyond field labour. Not estimated from Oslo crew logs. Published charging and routing studies support including transport costs, but do not establish this amount.

register.label: Held scooters that would have been ridden by someone else
register.scope: A held scooter is unavailable to other riders; this share of holds costs one lost ride each.

register.label: Placements a month the current night crews can absorb
register.scope: Beyond this, extra shifts are needed.

register.label: Extra cost of placements beyond capacity
register.scope: Night shift and overtime supplement.

register.label: Support cost per booking
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Booked rides that are extra rides
register.scope: Of rides taken on a booked scooter, the share that would not have happened on Voi without the booking.

register.label: Extra upgrades to Voi Pass per booking customer
register.scope: Applies in proportion to the bookings the Pass includes; zero for a paid add-on.

register.label: Non-booker lapse reduction per unit placement exposure
register.scope: Assumed absolute monthly effect, capped at baseline lapse and weighted by actual booking-driven placements / initial CS+TC customers. Zero placements gives zero spillover.

register.label: Months to full adoption after launch
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Social occasions per SLS customer
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Occasions that fit the 22:00 window
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Occasions where a group is started
register.scope: Of eligible social occasions, the share where someone starts a group in Voi Together.

register.label: Chance all scooters are at the meeting point
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Highest availability the fleet can supply
register.scope: A ceiling: the hold and Hub & Book cannot push availability above what the local fleet can supply at one point.

register.label: Feature: short group hold at the meeting point
register.scope: Raises availability; unused holds block individual rides.

register.label: Availability gain from the group hold
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Group holds that go unused
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Chance an unused hold blocks another ride
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Availability gain when Hub & Book also runs
register.scope: Denser supply in hub zones helps groups too. Counted only when both offers run.

register.label: Groups that complete once scooters are there
register.scope: Of groups with scooters available, the share where everyone actually rides.

register.label: Scooters per group
register.scope: Group Rides supports up to five vehicles.

register.label: Feature: split payment between accounts
register.scope: Every guest pays and registers; new guests add friction.

register.label: Completion lost when new guests must register
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Extra payment cost per guest (split)
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Occasions offered the group incentive
register.scope: The incentive applies only at suitable places and times, not as a permanent discount.

register.label: Group incentive on targeted occasions
register.scope: Discount on the normal price for group trips on targeted occasions.

register.label: Demand response to the incentive
register.scope: Unestimated planning coefficient. Default 2; range 0–4. Zero-response case is compared explicitly.

register.label: Incentive at which starts are estimated
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Group trips that are additional
register.scope: Ut sammen aims at trips out to an activity, 17–22, where the alternative is a shared taxi, the tram or not going. Assumed 47% (40% for the core offer); not measured.

register.label: Guests new to Voi
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: New guests seen for the first time
register.scope: Removes repeat appearances: a friend who joins three groups is counted once.

register.label: New guests who register (host pays)
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Registered guests who take a first paid ride
register.scope: Only guests who then pay for a ride of their own enter the portfolio as Occasional riders; registration alone earns nothing.

register.label: Guests who ride again after a split-payment trip
register.scope: With split payment every guest already has an account and has paid once, so fewer of them are genuinely new riders.

register.label: Groups per host
register.scope: Retention and repeat-use effects apply once per host, not once per group.

register.label: Hosts who start riding weekly
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Feature: join by link without the app
register.scope: Guests open the invitation in the browser and check in to the group; only the host needs the app.

register.label: More groups started when guests can join by link
register.scope: 25% means 6.0% of occasions become 7.5%. The share of groups abandoned because a friend lacks the app is not measured.

register.label: Feature: incentive only where it changes behaviour
register.scope: Uplift targeting: the incentive goes to occasions where a test shows it gets more groups started.

register.label: Incentive kept away from trips that would happen anyway
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Feature: first ride free for new guests
register.scope: After a group trip, a new guest gets their first own ride free.

register.label: Extra guests who take a ride of their own with the credit
register.scope: Percentage points added to guest activation. Costs one ride’s net revenue per activated guest.

register.label: Feature: event and venue partners
register.scope: Venues and events that end before 22:00 pay Voi for the groups they receive; partner duties, cost and funding are explicit.

register.label: Occasions at contracted partner venues or events
register.scope: A planning target of 10% if partners are added (a handful of venues and events covering about one evening occasion in ten). No agreement exists, so the evidence-conservative case uses 0.

register.label: More groups started at partner occasions
register.scope: Applied only to partner-linked occasions, and capped so that no more groups start than there are occasions.

register.label: Voi cost per partner trip
register.scope: Variable cost of serving a partner trip (promotion, settlement). The partnership capability itself is a separate setup and running cost.

register.label: Partner funding per trip
register.scope: Assumed 15 kr per partner trip, paid only on trips from partner-linked occasions. No venue has agreed to it; the zero-funding stress test shows the case without it.

register.label: Support cost per group trip
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Months to full adoption after launch
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Pilot coverage before the gate
register.scope: Share of eligible customers and hubs in the pilot; full coverage after a passed gate.

register.label: Holdout group (not offered)
register.scope: Randomly chosen eligible customers who are not offered the service, so its effect can be measured.

register.label: Holdout kept in a direct rollout
register.scope: A direct rollout offers the service to everyone eligible from launch. At 0% no comparison group is kept, so the effects are never measured against one.

register.label: Gate month
register.scope: The month in which each offer is continued or stopped on the pilot’s measurements.

register.label: Scale-up cost after the gate: Hub & Book
register.scope: More hubs, night-route capacity, analytics. Paid after a passed gate in a pilot, or at launch in a direct rollout.

register.label: Scale-up cost after the gate: Voi Together
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Shutdown cost if stopped: Hub & Book
register.scope: One-off cost of closing the offer: app change, customer messages, outstanding credits.

register.label: Shutdown cost if stopped: Voi Together
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Months until the Oslo permit ends
register.scope: Two-year permits with no extension; the current one began 1 April 2025. Month 0 = October 2026.

register.label: Length of each new permit
register.scope: Scenario parameter; not a measured causal effect.

register.label: Chance Oslo renews Voi without the offers
register.scope: Oslo replaced incumbents in 2022, 2023 and 2024; Voi lost Bergen in 2026.

register.label: Renewal effect of Hub & Book (judgement)
register.scope: Zero by default and never in the headline.

register.label: Renewal effect of Voi Together (judgement)
register.scope: Zero by default; the late-night design sets it negative.

register.label: Pilot measurement error (relative)
register.scope: How precisely the pilot measures each behavioural input at the gate.

register.label: How strongly related inputs move together
register.scope: Correlation of inputs within a group (demand, additionality, delivery, retention). 0 = independent; 0.5 = central case.

trial.reason: Enter eligible participants, clusters, cluster size, ICC, attrition, contribution SD, minimum worthwhile effect and baseline lapse. No measured precision is assumed.

limits: Scenario model, not a validated forecast or causal estimate.
Sample segment shares are not measured population shares.
Average fleet cost is a proxy, not measured marginal Oslo cost.
Retention and future acquisition depend on assumptions.

archivedReference.scope: Illustrative Oslo scale; old assumptions and old logic. Not comparable to the 10,000-customer v7 planning case without adjusting scope and mechanics.

forecastAudit.conclusion: No compatible historical scooter trip series was obtained in this audit. This is a data-availability finding, not proof that none exists. Explicit seasonality scenarios are used.

sources.name: Entur Mobility v2
sources.limit: Availability/status feed; not a validated historical trip-count series. Vehicle disappearance cannot be treated as a completed ride. The inspected developer.entur.org documentation identifies itself as the old portal; recheck developer.entur.no before implementation against live APIs.

sources.name: Oslo City Bike historical data
sources.use: Public monthly files of anonymised bike trips.
sources.limit: Different mode and service. Suitable as an explicitly labelled analogue or method demonstration, not observed Voi scooter demand.

sources.name: Ruter annual travel report 2025
sources.use: Annual scooter-market totals: 11.2m trips in 2024 and 20.4m in 2025.
sources.limit: Annual totals cannot identify weekly or annual seasonality. Fleet cap and service area expanded in April 2025, creating a structural break. Full-page retrieval returned 403; annual totals were available in the indexed primary-source text and the saved source register.

sources.name: Prophet diagnostics
sources.limit: A fitted model is adopted only after comparison against a seasonal baseline at one and three months, across three forecast origins.

requiredData: Daily completed rental scooter trip counts by operator/city for at least 1000 consecutive calendar days, with at least 90% observed days.
Dated fleet/service-area/regulatory changes; define a comparable regime or model changes explicitly.
Source licence, collection dates, time zone and distinction between missing and zero rides.
No causal adoption, elasticity or retention inference from aggregate trip forecasts.
